headline_options: The relocation system that refuses to guess.
Corridor intelligence that shows its work - and withholds what a lawyer hasn't signed.
tone: Concrete, trust-first, no hype, no certification language.

say: Case Command serves approved requirement_items per corridor - not a raw LLM dump.

Every requirement carries a verification_status (representative -> corpus_grounded -> expert_verified). Only a licensed human can flip a row to expert_verified; automated producers are structurally blocked. Rows awaiting sign-off surface as 'Legal review pending', not as fact.
HR builds relocation policy on a benefit-matrix canvas: tiers, targeting, per-benefit values, vendor tagging (incl. a 'Concierge'-tagged Paris housing supplier).
Country/city research runs through a stub research provider that only produces candidate official-source URLs. Its output is draft provenance and is NOT shown to end users until verified.
